outcome: offspring body mass index at three years of age
cohort: The study included 2548 live-born singleton mother-child pairs residing in Odense municipality, Denmark, from 2010-2013.
finding: Maternal polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) was not independently associated with insulin resistance or offspring birthweight after accounting for BMI and age, respectively, but both PCOS and high maternal BMI may increase the risk of childhood obesity at three years of age.
